top_signals.title: Copper Erases Nvidia Bounce on ‘Multiple Reasons’ to Be Short
top_signals.summary: Copper erased a one-day gain sparked by Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia Corp., with prices tumbling back toward the $12,000-a-ton level in London as demand and interest-rate concerns returned to the fore.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: China Warns Huang Comeback Doesn’t End ‘Malicious’ Risks From US
top_signals.summary: Jensen Huang’s return to the helm of Nvidia Corp. restores the AI industry’s most prominent opponent of chip controls against China. Already, Beijing has signaled it sees little reason to expect Washington’s restrictions to ease.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Bitcoin slips back toward $60,000 as Jensen Huang’s Nvidia return rally fizzles
top_signals.summary: Analysts said Huang's return was a reflex rally that did not resolve the macro headwinds bitcoin is facing as a risk asset.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
